# Speccify 0.11.5

## What changed

- Keep a reusable Agent and open its earlier local Codex or Claude Code conversations from Connections. Reading starts no process.
- Preview and explicitly link older conversations from the current working directory. New starts are linked when their exact host identity is confirmed.
- Continue the selected conversation, or fork a new Codex session with its history. Model options remain; the original task in the start command is not sent again.
- Private conversation references stay on this Mac; messages stay in the host's own store. Renaming preserves the Agent identity. History is not automatically synchronized or combined into shared memory.

## Included Specs

- `2088-fruhere-agent-sitzungen-anzeigen-und-gezielt-fortsetzen`: visible local history and explicit continuation.
- `2089-mac-patch-0-11-5-prufen-und-veroffentlichen`: independent Mac patch, website, help and normal update verification.

## Update or install

Mac-only patch through the regular updater and Mac download. Windows remains at 0.11.0; its next planned release is 0.12.0.

## Verification

The exact Mac candidate passes all 129 local check steps, including frontend, native, browser and offline-runtime checks. Native Computer Use verifies reading, explicit linking, exact conversation continuation and a separate fork, with retained work and no replay of the original task. The candidate-bound product video is reviewed. The app and DMG are signed, accepted by Apple, stapled and verified by Gatekeeper. The normal productive update is checked separately after publication.

## Limits

Local default Codex and Claude Code history stores are supported. Tool output, internal instructions and reasoning are omitted. A fork whose new ID is not confirmed can be linked explicitly. Missing, changed, archived or oversized histories remain visible as unavailable; no implicit latest-conversation fallback. A stopped process is not a successful-task claim.
